note: Every source this site reads, by id. Data files and individual records point at these with a `src` key rather than repeating the publisher, the URL and the licence. Written by the refresh scripts; do not edit by hand.

gr-clerk-current-election.publisher: City of Grand Rapids, City Clerk's Office
gr-clerk-current-election.licence: Public record of the City of Grand Rapids.
gr-clerk-current-election.covers: Grand Rapids early voting dates, sites and absentee drop boxes
gr-clerk-current-election.note: The source of record for the city. The county's pages are the cross-check, not the other way round. GAP: the City Hall drop box appears here only as prose, with no address and no hours, so it cannot be routed to or acted on from this page alone. Worth asking the clerk to publish it the way the other ten are.

mdos-dropbox-report-2026-11.publisher: Michigan Department of State, Bureau of Elections
mdos-dropbox-report-2026-11.licence: Public record of the State of Michigan.
mdos-dropbox-report-2026-11.covers: Absentee ballot drop box locations, hours and clerk, statewide, for the November 3 2026 general election
mdos-dropbox-report-2026-11.note: Obtained by FOIA request, released 2026-09-21 as November_2026_DropboxLocationReport_09212026.csv; the Bureau publishes it at no URL, so the link above is the Bureau rather than the release and there is no archive copy to take. The request asked for three statewide records: election day polling places at precinct level, early voting sites with their dates and hours, and drop boxes. Only the drop box report is read here, and only for the 24 Kent County jurisdictions whose county page publishes no box. VERIFIED AGAINST THIS PROJECT: the release agrees with precincts.json on all 202 Kent precincts, 30 jurisdictions and every ward. GAPS IN THE RELEASE, so it is not treated as authoritative beyond drop boxes: the early voting file covers 36 of 83 counties and 375 of 1,521 jurisdictions, omitting Oakland County entirely; the polling place file has three Grand Rapids ZIPs wrong, checked against USPS (see polling.json).

mvic-voter-lookup.publisher: Michigan Voter Information Center, Bureau of Elections
mvic-voter-lookup.licence: Public record of the State of Michigan.
mvic-voter-lookup.covers: Drop box addresses and hours the city clerk publishes only as prose
mvic-voter-lookup.note: Read by hand from a voter lookup on the date above, and NOT tracked: MVIC is behind a bot challenge, this project does not drive one, and nothing here will notice when it changes. Re-read it by hand whenever the clerk's page changes. It is recorded because the fact came from here and attributing it to the clerk would be false.
